schema.name: nodes_ad
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER nodes_ad AFTER DELETE ON nodes BEGIN INSERT INTO nodes_fts(nodes_fts, rowid, id, name, qualified_name, docstring, signature) VALUES ('delete', OLD.rowid, OLD.id, OLD.name, OLD.qualified_name, OLD.docstring, OLD.signature); END

schema.name: nodes_ai

schema.name: nodes_au
